items.note: The overview says outright that the product is a B2B note-taking app.

The audience is the engineering and design leads, and the migration question explains why it matters to each group. One small issue: the document calls itself a pre-read for deciding whether to start, rather than a kickoff document.
Creating a workspace, inviting members by email and shared notes are all in scope, and each has its own requirements section.
The only roles are admin and member, and 5.4.5 says there are no others in v1.
The non-goals list covers billing changes, SSO and guest access.
The metric is stated exactly: 20% of paid accounts create a workspace within 60 days.
The document is about 1,300–1,400 words plus a permissions table, with long lists of evidence gaps and assumptions. That is roughly 3–4 pages, well over the limit of about 2.
Q1 states that the migration question is kept open. It lists the options without recommending one and explains what it means for engineering and design.
